बड़ी खबर! देसी गर्ल प्रियंका चोपड़ा ले आई हैं एक और धमाकेदार तोहफा। 🎬
प्रियांक चोपड़ा जोनास ने अपनी 2016 की मराठी फिल्म Ventilator का सीक्वल Ventilator 2 लाने का ऐलान कर दिया है।
इस आने वाली फिल्म को प्रियंका के बैनर Purple Pebble Pictures और Magij Pictures के तहत प्रोड्यूस किया जाएगा।
डायरेक्टर राजेश मापुस्कर एक बार फिर राइटर और डायरेक्टर के रूप में प्रियंका के साथ वापसी कर रहे हैं।
फिल्म की रिलीज डेट 2027 तय की गई है, जबकि कास्ट और कहानी की डिटेल्स अभी सामने नहीं आई हैं।
इंस्टाग्राम पर प्रियंका ने बताया कि 10 साल पहले उन्होंने meaningful कहानियां कहने के लिए कंपनी बनाई थी।
आपको बता दें कि ओरिजिनल फिल्म Ventilator को तीन नेशनल फिल्म अवॉर्ड मिले थे।
क्या आप प्रियंका की इस फिल्म के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? 🍿

ctx.text:
Priyanka Chopra Jonas has announced the sequel to her 2016 Marathi film Ventilator , titled Ventilator 2 . The upcoming project will be produced under her banner Purple Pebble Pictures and will see her reunite with filmmaker Rajesh Mapuskar, who returns as the writer and director. The film is scheduled to release in 2027, while details about its cast and storyline are yet to be revealed.
Announcing the project on Instagram, Priyanka looked back at the original film and spoke about its significance in her journey as a producer. She also reflected on the vision behind Purple Pebble Pictures, which was established to support stories with meaningful narratives.
Sharing the announcement, she wrote, “10 years ago, with @purplepebblepictures, I decided I want to tell stories that mean something. Ventilator was one of those very important stories to us at the company. A decade later, we’re coming back to it, with so much more…”
Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Dr Madhu Chopra, and Rajesh Mapuskar will produce Ventilator 2 under the banners of Purple Pebble Pictures and Magij Pictures. The reunion brings back the filmmaker who directed the original, which received three National Film Awards.
Released in 2016, Ventilator revolved around the Kamerkar family, whose members come together at a hospital after an elderly family member is placed on a ventilator just before Ganesh Chaturthi. The Marathi film explored family relationships, generational differences and unresolved tensions through a combination of humour and emotional moments.
Mapuskar received the National Film Award for Best Director, while the film also won awards for Best Editing and Best Sound Mixing.
Founded by Priyanka, Purple Pebble Pictures has backed projects across different languages and genres. Its filmography includes Pahuna: The Little Visitors , Paani , The Sky Is Pink , The White Tiger , Firebrand , To Kill a Tiger and Anuja .
With Ventilator 2 , the production house returns to one of its early projects, bringing Priyanka and Mapuskar together for another chapter. Further details about the film's production and cast are awaited.
